newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Banca Agricola cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Romania Banca Agricola cuts deposit rates.

text.p: Romanian state-run bank Banca Agricola SA said on Tuesday it had lowered interest rates on individuals' leu deposits starting July 21.
A bank statement said sight deposit rates were cut to an annual 16 percent from 20 percent, while one-month deposits would pay 56 percent, down from 65 percent previously.
It said three-month deposits carried 61 percent annual interest, down from a previous 75 percent, while six-month rates dropped to 68 percent from 96 percent.
The rate on one-year deposits fell to 72 from 78 percent.
The move follows recent drops in interest rates on the market after monthly inflation slowed down to 2.3 percent last month from 4.3 percent in May and 6.9 percent in April.
The bank's lending rates range from 62 percent to 82 percent, the statement said.
Banca Agricola farm lender has the largest network across Romania and is to be restructured before turning private under a bank selloff bill.
